lines.en: label kaoricamp1:
scene kaorianotherhunt1
: Friendburger! You have returnedburger! Did you forget to rub Frog Boy for good luck?
: Yup. That’s exactly why I came back. You know me so well, Kaori.
scene kaorianotherhunt2
: I could not call myself a friend if I did not understand when you desired the rubbing of a special frog. All in a day’s job.
: Go on, Friend. Rub the Frog Boy and carry on with your tree-based day of resting. Nao-chan and I have much job to do and have not included your mouthwords in our daily time budget.
: Well, what are you two doing exactly? Maybe I can tag along.
scene kaorianotherhunt3
: A long what?

: No, Nao-chan. Friend wants to play tag because he is larger than us and knows he can win. It is in periods like this where we must decide against bending as we are not pipe cleaners with human parts. Right, Friend?
: Sure. But you still haven’t told me what you’re doing.
: Do you not have the job to do?
: The only job I came here with was making sure my niece isn’t entirely miserable all day. But I think I’ve already failed that as she’s been kidnapped by Sara.
: The Sara is here too? I do not have time to serve dizzy drinks to customers today. Especially customers in the tree village as those customers are animals and can not consume most human beverages.
: Don’t worry. Sara has the day off and I won’t let her know you’re here. But what are you so busy with anyway? I figured you two would be enjoying a rare day off or something.
scene kaorianotherhunt4
: Exactly!
: I can’t consistently speak Nao’s silent language yet, Kaori. Please translate.
scene kaorianotherhunt5
: Nao-chan says that you can still enjoy the workless work day while working!
: But then it wouldn’t-
: Do not search for answers, Friend! It is the question that truly matters!
: Is there confusion in your head-house?
: There’s a lot in my head-house and confusion is only one of the inhabitants. I still don’t know what you’re doing, though.
: Do you recall the flattened tree corpse that eventually led to our discovery of Nao-chan in the beginning place?
: The...treasure map thing that was taped to your door?
: Correct. The flattened tree corpse. I have received another one.
scene kaorianotherhunt6
: Does it have more than just a symbol written on it this time?
: There were no words and no symbols written on this one. But that is okay for I already understand where I am supposed to go!
: How?
: Because nothingness is Nao-chan’s language and she was able to draw a picture of the location we must return to! How convenient it is to know a human who can out-human other humans!
scene kaorianotherhunt7
: So...you two came all the way out here because you got a blank sheet of paper and interpreted it as a treasure map to something located in a remote forest?
: That is not incorrect.
: Did Nao at least tell you what the treasure is?
: We believe the treasure is the material or materials we require to build a special machine that will help us better understand human emotions!
: I see...
I don’t actually see. But that’s probably not something I have to directly inform you of since you’ve likely experienced enough secondhand Kaori to know that nothing she does make sense.
And, while I’m not sure if I want to assist her on another wild goose chase that could potentially result in one more kidnapping, I’ve gotta say-
I’m intrigued by what the colors of the eyes on this one would be.
scene kaorianotherhunt8
stop kidding yourself. you know you just want one to keep as a souvenir since spider girl gets to have this one all to herself.
but there is no one here and no one for me to keep as a souvenir and you are wrong parold dolia you are very very wrong
things still exist here. you’ve just stopped seeing them for now. the same way you stopped seeing macaroni girl for a little while before she went poof.
could this mean that there is still macaroni left over
scene kaorianotherhunt9
how about a macaron instead
it is my favorite
scene kaorianotherhunt6
: Did the macarons happen?
: How do you know about the-
: Nao-chan informed me of something known as “macaron time” that happens when a brain gets less brainy than a brain is meant to brain.
scene kaorianotherhunt10
: Don’t just give me a thumbs up when you should be chasing after your frog. And how do you know what’s going on inside of my head?
scene kaorianotherhunt11
: Maybe it is because she also has a head? Humans need heads or they will be headless like Michael.
: I have no idea who that-
: Yes you do. Will you come along for the hunt of the treasure supplies, Friend? Maybe there will be macarons there and you will not have to battle hunger any longer?
: Wait. I’m not ready to- Sure.
menu:
engage macaron time
scene macaron1

scene kaorianotherhunt12
: What?
: The movement of the earth-breath suggests that we are in the right location, but I see no supplies other than grass or snailbugs. And they will not help us make the machine.
scene kaorianotherhunt13
: Have we been here before? This place seems familiar.
: This is the twin of the first forest. It’s where the treasure is meant to be kept, but no treasure can ever be found. What do you suggest we do next, Nao-chan?
: I think your suggestion is good. But I am worried of what will happen to you if you walk away from the line that helps me see things.
: It is true that Friend is here to help. But friend can only hold what he’s allowed to. His arms become weak when he’s forced to carry things he can not fit beneath his bed-box.
scene kaorianotherhunt14
: Wait! Nao-chan!
: She’s an arguably otherworldly being. I’m sure she’ll be able to find her way back, Kaori.
: But there is the possibility that she will encounter a furry enemy rather than a furry friend! A hungry bear could turn Nao-chan into No-chan! Or Nothing-chan! Or Food-chan!
: So could John and you keep him in your apartment.
scene kaorianotherhunt15
: John has begun to shrink as some of his great chicken powers are now being distributed to Frog Boy, human frog. Nao-chan is no longer in any danger of becoming chicken food.
: Well that’s good. It means we only have to worry about her frog becoming gigantic next and then eating everything because that is what frogs do.
: Frog Boy is one of the good guys. He will protect us from the darkness and join us in the color machine.
: Color machine? Is that the thing you were talking about that will help you better understand human emotions or whatever?
: Of course, Friend. That is what colors are — symbols and icons of what we feel or think. We all have them, and sometimes they change. But sometimes they don’t.
scene kaorianotherhunt16
: You were clear when we first met, Friend. But you are much darker now. Which means that something must have changed in your living-life.
: Did a cloud of sadness sneak into your mouth when our tongues touched?
scene kaorianotherhunt17
: No, Kaori. A cloud of sadness did not sneak into my mouth when our tongues touched. I’ve just been so busy hating myself lately that my clear aura must be decaying from lack of proper care.
: Like a frog!
: Sure. Exactly like a frog.
scene kaorianotherhunt18
: Do you have a favorite thing about frogs, Friend? Do you know why I gave one to Nao-chan?
: I do not. To both of those questions.
: The best frog fact is how they can turn themselves off in the winter! The wood frog can freeze two thirds of its body and it makes a special slime that protects its body from the cold.
: And that’s why you got one for Nao? So she could use its natural oils to...lubricate herself?
: Incorrectamundo! Frog Boy is Nao-chan’s frog boy because she must learn responsibility and Frog Boy is strong enough to exist without her!
: As Nao-chan’s mothermom, it is my responsibility to make her know what responsibility is. So she has a frog now so she can try to be responsible but can make mistakes since Frog Boy is strong.
scene kaorianotherhunt19
: Even as a child frog, Frog Boy can still protect himself when the hot turns to cold without anyone’s help at all.
: But if you leave a human out in the cold, it will freeze and unalive. Which is why you must give small humans a blanket.

: I think I get what you’re saying. And I don’t think it’s a bad idea. But, at the same time, if Nao makes mistakes, which she will since she’s so young, won’t her actions changing the frog’s “color” upset you?
: If I’ve become “darker” lately because I haven’t been taking care of myself, I don’t want the change in Frog Boy’s tone upsetting either of you.
: You may believe your color has changed because you are not taking the cares for yourself, Friend — but that is your thought alone!
: Do you think it’s something else?
: I think you are just cold because no one ever gave you a blanket. You are not Frog Boy. You can not freeze two thirds of your body when the heat isn’t hot anymore.
: So what you’re saying is...my color has been destined to change from the start since no one ever gave me a blanket?
scene kaorianotherhunt20
: I never met the small you. But the big you is a good you. So I can’t say whether or not the you that isn’t you anymore is the color it was destined to be.
: But maybe the you that is inside of you is?
: There is no “me inside of me,” Kaori.
scene kaorianotherhunt21
: Sure there is.
: If there is a me inside of me, there must be a you inside of you. It’s the only thing that makes sense.
: For example — my outside color is green, but my inside color is red because the other me is a different me.

: Sure. But I also haven’t ruled out the possibility that you’re literally just possessed after you threw yourself at me outside of your apartment. So maybe that “you inside of you” isn’t actually you at all?
: I am confused. Please explain that to me in simpler human terms.
: Your explanation was worded the same exact way, so don’t go pretending you don’t know what I’m talking about, Kaori.
: All of this shit with colors and how I’m darker now has nothing to do with the way I was brought up or growing up without a blanket. I’m darker now because I’ve lost the only thing keeping me sane.
scene kaorianotherhunt22
: And you are out of sane now?
: I’m sad. I’m lonely. And I’m here to try and start over, but I can’t even do that because the girl who will be the key to it is currently getting a makeover in a tent I’m not allowed to enter.
: How do you know that the human female you are referencing is the key?
: Deductive reasoning, I guess? She’s the one thing tying each terrible bit of my past together. And I’ve failed her so many times that, at this rate, she’ll be the next thing I lose.
scene kaorianotherhunt23
: This line of human-thinking is very sad, Friend. Yours will be the first I fix when I create the color machine. But until then, I do not know if I will be able to understand the way you think.
: And I don’t blame you for that. It’s complicated. But I’m glad you’re at least...thinking about me, I guess.
: I am almost always thinking about you, Friend. Especially now that there’s an extra me inside of me.
: Does that make you sad as well?
: Not sad, no.
: Just a little uncomfortable.
scene kaorianotherhunt22
: Uncomfortable?
: That “other you” reminds me of someone.
: Someone you dislike?
: Yes.
: But also no.
: Again, it’s complicated.
scene kaorianotherhunt24
: This is why we must create the color machine!
: The corpsemap would not lead me astray! And there are so many special metals beneath the ground! They must be unearthed before night falls and the sun goes to sleep!
: Kaori, I know I came out here to help you, but I really don’t want to start digging up random minerals from the ground on what’s supposed to be a day of rest for me.
scene kaorianotherhunt25
: That is okay. I will kill the dirt myself.
: Where did you even get that?
: Yes.
: What?
scene kaorianotherhunt26
: Since you are an assistant to the treasure hunter and not a real treasure hunter yourself, perhaps you could play a one-sided game of seek and hide and discover where Nao-chan ran off to?
: I’m very worried about her. She has seemed eager to explore the tree village since the moment we arrived.
: Sure, but...come to think of it, how did you two get here in the first place? You don’t drive.
scene kaorianotherhunt27
: The same way I go to and from my many jobs, Friend.
: Which is?
: Yes.
scene sky
: Okay. Forget it. I’ll go look for Nao.
: Thank you, Friend!
: Oh! And please tell Nao-chan to bring back dinner for Frog Boy in case her memory is not properly functioning! There are worms near the water! Offspring of the contaminant!
: I’ll be sure to do that, Kaori.
scene black
I leave Kaori to her own devices or...whichever devices she plans on creating after unearthing “mysterious metals” from the forest floor and think more about what she said about colors.
If even she’s noticed a change in my demeanor, it must be pretty apparent. Which, granted, I sort of expected. And that’s only beaten into me harder by the fact that everyone’s been noticing it.
But I kind of hoped she’d be an exception.
So long as there’s an extra “her” inside of her, though...I doubt that’ll change.
And I doubt I’ll be able to peel myself out of her mind either.
But...maybe that’s good.
Maybe I can expect more of whatever that borderline sexual assault shit was from a while back.
I mean, I’ve been borderline sexual assaulting tons of girls over the last few school years, so it’s only fair if more people start taking advantage of me too, right?
In fact, my assaults haven’t been borderline at all. They’ve just been assaults.

I’ve been doing terrible things and you’ve been watching me doing terrible things, but now that things are starting to get more terrible, it’s getting harder to convince yourself that other stuff wasn’t or isn’t terrible.
Right?
Isn’t that right?
Anyway, I’m in the forest now.
I’m in the forest now and I’m looking for someone.
